_context.generic: Shown when a chat message failed without any detail.
_context.titles.unauthorized: The AI connection (Claude, ChatGPT...) the coworker runs on needs its user to sign in again.
_context.titles.thinking_replay: A run is one turn of work of a coworker.
_context.limits.titles.window: {plan} is the name of an AI subscription (Claude, ChatGPT). {window} is weekly or monthly.
_context.limits.titles.model: {plan} is an AI subscription (Claude); {model} is a model family of it (Opus, Sonnet).
_context.limits.titles.opencodeWindow: OpenCode Go is the name of a paid plan. {window} is weekly or monthly.
_context.limits.messages.opencodeCredits: Console is the pay-as-you-go side of OpenCode, Go its subscription. Both are product names.
_context.limits.messages.opencodeWindowResets: {window} is the limit's period: weekly, monthly, or a 5-hour window. {resetsAt} is a time written by the provider in English, e.g. 'Nov 6, 3:00 PM UTC'.
_context.limits.messages.weeklyResets: {plan} is an AI subscription (Claude, ChatGPT). {resetsAt} is a time written by the provider in English, e.g. '6:50pm (UTC)'.
_context.limits.messages.sessionResets: {plan} is an AI subscription (Claude, ChatGPT). {resetsAt} is a time written by the provider in English, e.g. '6:50pm (UTC)'.
_context.limits.messages.spend: {plan} is an AI subscription (Claude). The organization is the company account at the AI provider.

generic: Something went wrong. Try sending your message again.

modelAtCapacity.title: Model at capacity
modelAtCapacity.message: This model has no room right now. Try again in a moment or pick another model.

messages.budget: The account behind Rerun models has no balance left. Top it up, or switch to another model.
messages.unauthorized: This connection needs to be signed in again before the coworker can run.
messages.overloaded: The provider is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
messages.context_window: This conversation no longer fits the model, and sending it again will hit the same wall. Switch to a model with a larger context window, or start a new conversation.
messages.provider_error: The model provider refused this request, and sending it again will get the same answer. Switch to another model to keep going.
messages.thinking_replay: The engine replayed this turn in a way the model provider rejects. This is an engine bug, not the model: switching models will not help. Try again, and update the engine if it keeps happening.
messages.interrupted: The run was cut off before it could finish.
messages.session_gone: This coworker cannot reach this conversation anymore, so the message was not sent. Start a new conversation to keep going.

titles.opencodeWindow: OpenCode Go {window, select, weekly {weekly} other {monthly}} limit reached

messages.opencodeCredits: No Console credits left. Add credits on opencode.ai, or pick a Go model to keep going.
messages.opencodeWindowResets: Your OpenCode Go plan has reached its {window, select, weekly {weekly} monthly {monthly} other {5-hour}} limit. It resets {resetsAt}; switch to a Console model or another provider until then.
messages.opencodeWindow: Your OpenCode Go plan has reached its {window, select, weekly {weekly} monthly {monthly} other {5-hour}} limit. Switch to a Console model or another provider until it resets.
messages.modelUnavailable: This connection can't run {model}. Pick another model to keep going.
messages.anyModelUnavailable: This connection can't run this model. Pick another model to keep going.
messages.modelNotInPlan: Your {plan} plan doesn't include {model}. Pick another model to keep going.
messages.anyModelNotInPlan: Your {plan} plan doesn't include this model. Pick another model to keep going.
messages.usageLimit: This subscription has reached its usage limit. Switch to another model, or wait for the limit to reset.
messages.credits: Your {plan} plan has used up its usage credits. Pick a model your plan includes to keep going.
messages.spend: Your organization has reached its monthly {plan} spend limit. An admin can raise it; switch this coworker to another model in the meantime.
messages.weeklyResets: Your {plan} plan has reached its weekly limit. It resets {resetsAt}; switch this coworker to another model until then.
messages.weekly: Your {plan} plan has reached its weekly limit. Switch this coworker to another model until the week rolls over.
messages.model: Your {plan} plan has reached its {model} limit. The other {plan} models still run: switch to one of them.
messages.sessionResets: Your {plan} plan has used up its current usage window. It refills at {resetsAt}; switch this coworker to another model in the meantime.
messages.session: Your {plan} plan has used up its current usage window. It refills on its own; switch this coworker to another model in the meantime.
